items.title: Malik Nabers: Middling production in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Nabers secured five of seven targets for 44 yards and lost a fumble in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Isaiah Likely: Career-high receiving yardage in loss
items.text:
Likely brought in nine of 11 targets for 127 yards and a touchdown and fumbled once but recovered in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Pair of TDs in close loss
items.text:
Skattebo rushed 18 times for 78 yards and two touchdowns and brought in three of four targets for 44 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.
